definitions.explanation: A broad, all-encompassing view or reference work that covers an entire subject area. Often used as part of a book title or publication name to indicate comprehensive coverage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{総覧|そうらん}。
examples.english: A Comprehensive Survey of Japanese Art.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧{総覧|そうらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参考|さんこう}→参考：02828_sankou⟧にして⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I researched using a comprehensive guide to regional industries.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{総覧|そうらん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧・⟦{短期大学|たんきだいがく}→短期大学：27098_tankidaigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{網羅|もうら}→網羅：17581_moura⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧だ。
examples.english: This compendium covers information on all universities and junior colleges nationwide and is an indispensable resource for exam candidates.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ ('general; total') and {覧|らん} ('view; look over'). Often appears in the titles of reference books, directories, and encyclopedic surveys. The word implies that the work attempts to cover everything within a given field, not merely selected highlights.

USAGE:
Most commonly encountered as part of a publication title. The word can also be used as a suru-verb ({総覧|そうらん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, 'to survey comprehensively'), though this usage is less common. In contemporary usage, the word has a somewhat formal, reference-book feel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧{総覧|そうらん}: comprehensive guide to national universities
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{総覧|そうらん}: comprehensive art survey
- ⟦{産業|さんぎょう}→産業：01419_sangyou⟧{総覧|そうらん}: industry compendium
- {総覧|そうらん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to survey comprehensively

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {概覧|がいらん}: general overview — a briefer, less comprehensive survey
- ⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧: list; overview — a quick-reference list or table, less detailed than {総覧|そうらん}
- {便覧|びんらん}: handbook; manual — a practical reference for quick consultation
- ⟦{騒乱|そうらん}→騒乱：23902_souran⟧: riot; disturbance — homophone with different kanji; completely unrelated
